data.text:
ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA 

Pansamantalang isasara ang ilang lane sa North EDSA sa pagitan ng Landmark-Trinoma at Unified Grand Central Station para sa isasagawang Metro Rail Transit Line 7 (MRT-7) Turnback Girder Launching Activity sa mga sumusunod na araw: 

Northbound (Going Balintawak)
• Tower Support no. 2: 2 lanes closed at all times from Feb. 1 to May 8. 
• Girder Launching: Full road closure from 10 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting Feb. 11 to March 10. 

Southbound (Going Cubao)
• Tower Support no. 3: 2 lanes closed at all times from Feb. 22 to May 18. 
• Girder Launching: Full road closure from 10 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting March 11 to March 23.
